From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: TOM: Q: Do not replace until after (multiple) combats
Date: 5 May 1995 06:42:02 GMT

L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>Q: which cards are replaced at this point?
> 1. all cards.

A combat ended, so all "do not replace" cards are replaced, even if Psyche
or something is due to start another combat.

>Q: In the case of Form of Mist, Anson can still block and play reaction
> cards as if untapped (card text on WwEF), so he plays Enhanced Senses
> for +1 intercept and re-blocks, right?

Looks right, but I will check on that.

After checking, the ruling was upheld:

Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Design Team Rulings: 5/30/95
Date: 31 May 1995 22:12:08 GMT
Message-ID: <3qipjo$b...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

3) If superior Form of Mist is used to continue the action, the
minion that originally blocked the vampire may block it again as
per the normal procedures.

Messages.Author: D.P. Hammersley
Messages.Body:
Hello all,

A situation has arisen in our group concerning the use of
'wake with evening's freshness' and 'form of mist' superior.

Basically what happens is this:
Player A takes an action (say a bleed) which player B reacts
to with a WwEF. Player A now plays a FoM at superior to end
combat and continue at +1 stealth...

..At this point can the same reacting vampire still using
the same WwEF still attempt to block if they have the
intercept to match the +1 stealth OR must a second WwEF be
played? We always used to play the latter but the card
actually says that the reacter may continue to react until
the current action is concluded.

So 2 cases:

1. The action ends when the FoM is played as a combat ends
and therefore a second WwEF must be played.

OR

2. When FoM is played, like the card says, 'the action is
continued at +1 stealth' and therefore the reacter may still
continue to attempt to block if they have the intercept.

Any views appreciated.

Peter
